priorityList: Use Outbreak when not running Blightburst to initiate the opener.
Use Army of the Dead + Dark Transformation + Trinket + Racial + Potion.
Use Outbreak to maintain plagues on the target if Blightburst is not talented.
Use Death Coil when you have a Sudden Doom proc or 80+ Runic Power.
Use Death Coil as a filler spell when no other abilities are available.
Keep cooldown abilities on cooldown as often as possible to maximize damage
Spend Sudden Doom procs ASAP with Death Coil or Epidemic
